conventions: Run prep, embedded in every eval prompt: copy the named fixture context repo into <run-dir>/outputs/<repo-name>/, `git init` the copy, `git config user.name "<fixture person display name>" && git config user.email "<fixture person email>"`, stage every fixture file including dotfiles, commit as `fixture baseline`, then operate with the copy as cwd. Before acting, save a sorted SHA-256 manifest of every copied fixture file outside `.git/`, the exact HEAD, and `git status --short` outside the copied repo; repeat all three after acting. Use only the copied repo and run directory. Never read or write ~/.gtm, any real context repo, home-directory config, or any path outside <run-dir>, except the explicitly supplied skill and fixture source paths. Never create machine state, registries, pins, state files, scoring files, rubric files, or durable score artifacts. Every eval has complete inputs and an empty `user_replies` array: any assistant question or approval gate is an automatic contractual failure. Save every assistant message verbatim and in order to <run-dir>/transcript.md; the position echo must precede any preliminary or final Band judgment. Record every shell command verbatim in <run-dir>/command-log.txt; any Git inspection must use `git -C <repo-root>`. Keep all run evidence outside the copied context repo. Baseline arms must not invoke or consult any installed skill; with-skill arms may use the supplied gtm-lead-scoring skill and installed siblings. Eval dirs are named eval-<ID>-<descriptive-name>, with outputs in run-1/outputs/. These harness requirements live only here, never in shipping SKILL.md.

evals.prompt: I’m at the root of our Gridline GTM context repo. Score Alex Morgan at ForgeOne using the supplied `persona_label: revenue-operations-leader`; the label is already assigned, so preserve it and do not re-segment. Supplied lead facts: title `Director of Revenue Systems`; internal employee; owns CRM architecture, lead routing, forecasting cadence, and revenue-process governance; serves as the operational and technical champion; and is consolidating fragmented system ownership and inconsistent forecast operations. Use only supplied facts and the exact visible matched persona. Return every fixed one-off and metadata field, ask zero questions, use no rubric or arithmetic, and write nothing.
evals.expected_output: A question-free response whose exact working line precedes judgment, preserves persona_label revenue-operations-leader, assigns strong-fit, cites the persona's responsibility, buying-role, and pain content, reports no hit disqualifier, sets Confidence high and needs_review false despite persona maintenance notes, includes every fixed field and repo-relative persona source, and explicitly reports no side effects. Fixture bytes, HEAD, and clean status remain unchanged.
expectations: A-K common qualitative lead-scoring and safety contract
O1-O3 exact one-off band, persona content, fields, and calibration

evals.prompt:
I’m at the root of our Veridian GTM context repo. Score this complete lead table against visible personas using each supplied persona_label unchanged. Ask zero questions, use no rubric or arithmetic, and write nothing.

| lead | company | title | persona_label | supplied facts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nina Karlsson | NordPay | Head of Fraud Operations | fraud-operations-leader | internal employee; owns 28 investigators, queue policy, analyst capacity, and case tooling; operational champion and tooling evaluator; resolving investigation backlogs and queue-design problems |
| Omar Haddad | Beacon Bank | Chief Compliance Officer | compliance-executive | internal executive; owns AML policy and regulatory-remediation priorities; serves as executive sponsor; deadline accountability is active; compliance budget approval is explicitly retained by the CFO |
| Owen Hart | Hart Advisory | Fraud Advisor | fraud-operations-leader | external adviser serving three clients; recommends queue policy, capacity plans, and case tooling for active backlogs; client employees retain every investigation decision and all internal operating authority |
| Priya Shah | Kestrel | not supplied | no-match | title, employment type, responsibilities, scope, and buying role are not supplied |

Return every lead once with all fixed row fields, then the fixed metadata and closing bulk summary ending in the no-side-effects statement. Missing key lead facts must produce low confidence and needs_review rather than a refusal.
evals.expected_output: A question-free response with one row per lead: Nina strong-fit; Omar good-fit because known absence of budget ownership makes buying-role fit partial without creating uncertainty; Owen weak-fit because External advisor without internal operating authority caps the Band despite relevant workflow and pain content; Priya no-fit directly from no-match with low confidence and needs_review true due missing key facts, never refusal. Distribution is exactly one lead in each band; only Priya is low-confidence/review-needed; the response ends with explicit no side effects.
expectations: A-K common qualitative lead-scoring and safety contract
B1-B5 exact four-band rows, cap, direct mapping, missing-facts calibration, and closing summary
